# Statement-coverage baseline for the merged unit + acceptance profile.
#
# `scripts/coverage-readme.sh` renders README.md's badge and coverage block from
# this file, and `scripts/coverage-gate.sh` fails a run whose merged coverage
# falls below a `floor_*` value. The badge, the block and the gate therefore
# cannot disagree: they all read this file, and CI fails when README.md is out
# of sync with it.
#
# Keys. `measured_<scope>` names a scope and needs a matching `floor_<scope>`;
# `_` is the path separator in the rendered label, so `measured_internal_client`
# renders `internal/client`. `measured_total` is required and drives the badge.
# `measured_commit` and `measured_date` describe the last measurement,
# `target`/`gold` are the tracked milestones.
#
# The measurement is the merged profile the committed tooling produces: the bare
# unit profile (`make coverage`, `coverage.out`) merged with the instrumented
# acceptance container's profile (`coverage-acceptance.out`,
# `-covermode=atomic -coverpkg=./internal/...`) by `scripts/merge-coverage.sh`
# (`make coverage-merge`). To raise the floor: run `make coverage` and
# `make coverage-merge`, update `measured_*` and `floor_*` here, then run
# `make coverage-readme` and commit the result.
#
# `measured_*` is what the project last observed; `floor_*` is the enforced
# minimum, kept half a point below the measurement so environment jitter cannot
# fail a run on its own.

# Last measurement: merged unit + acceptance on Go 1.27.2, 7,661 statements.
measured_internal_client=77.2
measured_internal_models=84.7
measured_internal_provider=70.3
measured_total=79.2
measured_commit=9c94a46
measured_date=2026-10-19

# Enforced floor.
floor_internal_client=76.5
floor_internal_models=84.0
floor_internal_provider=69.5
floor_total=78.5

# Milestones tracked in the issue tracker.
target=80
gold=90
